name: d3-skills

owner.name: Data Driven Decisions (D3) Group, University of Würzburg

description: Claude Code skills of the D3 group for research communication: abstracts, posters, presentations, and interactive project explainers in the D3 corporate design, with a shared scientific wording layer

plugins.name: d3-abstract
plugins.description: D3-branded abstracts, one-pagers and research updates as A4 PDFs (LaTeX)

plugins.name: d3-poster
plugins.description: D3-branded A0 conference posters from a paper or repo (LaTeX, baposter)

plugins.name: d3-presentation
plugins.description: D3-branded presentations as LaTeX Beamer PDFs or interactive HTML decks with designed objects, a presenter view and Q&A interactions

plugins.name: d3-explainer
plugins.description: Interactive HTML explainer of a research repo (code, paper, vault) for its own authors and co-authors

plugins.name: d3-scientific-wording
plugins.description: Wording layer of the D3 skills: direct claims, neutral related work, claims within the evidence, short sentences, outlet-aware register, optional Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100), wording lint

plugins.name: d3-marimo
plugins.description: Interactive teaching apps as marimo notebooks that run in the browser (WASM) on the chair website, in the University of Würzburg look
